approvalId.description: Caller-chosen request identifier; reusing it retries the same request.

targetKind.description: Scope dimension the approval is bound to.

targetId.description: Exact bound value of that scope dimension.

requestedAtMs.description: Explicit request timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

expiresAtMs.description: Explicit expiry timestamp in Unix milliseconds, after requestedAtMs.

arguments.description: Exact invocation arguments; their canonical JSON hash is bound to the request.
